// =====================================================
// STEP 24: PLANT-LEVEL FEATURE TABLE
// Export this for K-means and Lasso in Python
// =====================================================

MATCH (p:Plant)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(f:Family)
RETURN
  p.id AS plant_id,
  p.name AS plant_name,
  p.irishName AS irish_name,
  f.name AS family,
  p.famineFood AS famine_food,
  p.toxicityClass AS toxicity_class,
  p.ailmentCount AS ailment_count,
  p.categoryCount AS category_count,
  p.shopCount AS shop_count,
  p.locationCount AS location_count,
  p.degreeCentrality AS degree_centrality,
  p.betweenness AS betweenness,
  p.communityId AS community_id,
  p.accessPattern AS access_pattern,
  p.isSafeMultiUse AS safe_multi_use
ORDER BY plant_name;

query:
// 1. Find plants and their ailments to build the community profile
MATCH (p:Plant)-[:TREATS]->(a:Ailment)
WITH p.communityId AS communityId, 
     collect(DISTINCT a.name)[0..10] AS sampleAilments,
     collect(DISTINCT p.name) AS allPlantsInCommunity

// 2. Re-match plants to get individual stats, filtered by the communities found above
MATCH (p:Plant)
WHERE p.communityId = communityId
RETURN p.communityId AS communityId,
       p.name AS plant,
       p.degreeCentrality AS degreeCentrality,
       p.ailmentCount AS ailmentCount,
       sampleAilments,
       // We can also show how many other plants are in this same cluster
       size(allPlantsInCommunity) AS totalPlantsInCommunity
ORDER BY communityId, degreeCentrality DESC;

// =====================================================
// RESULT 15: CONDITION -> HERB QUERY
// Core deployment / explainable feature
// =====================================================

WITH 'Respiratory' AS searchTerm

MATCH (p:Plant)-[:TREATS]->(a:Ailment)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:IN_CATEGORY]->(c:AilmentCategory)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:AVAILABLE_AT]->(s:Shop)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:FOUND_IN]->(l:WildLocation)

WHERE toLower(a.name) = toLower(searchTerm)
   OR toLower(c.name) = toLower(searchTerm)

RETURN
  searchTerm AS searchInput,
  p.name AS plant,
  p.irishName AS irishName,
  p.toxicityClass AS toxicity,
  collect(DISTINCT a.name) AS matchedUses,
  collect(DISTINCT s.name) AS shops,
  collect(DISTINCT l.name) AS wildLocations
ORDER BY plant;

CALL gds.nodeSimilarity.stream('plantSimilarityGraph')
YIELD node1, node2, similarity
WITH gds.util.asNode(node1) AS p1,
     gds.util.asNode(node2) AS p2,
     similarity
RETURN p1.name AS plant1,
       p2.name AS plant2,
       round(similarity, 3) AS similarity
ORDER BY similarity DESC
LIMIT 15;
